title: Eleven Sacks of Apples for a Lathe
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：trade　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trade 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Everybody in the ① trade knew my grandfather, by which I mean the eleven men within twenty miles who did the same work, and they all knew that he had a ② trade and had learned it properly, in seven years, which none of the rest had. He said a ③ trade is not a living but a thing you can still do with your hands when everything else has gone, and in 1974, when everything else went, he was right.

The ④ trade he was proudest of was not a job at all: in 1961 he had swapped eleven sacks of apples for a lathe, and he said a trade is only fair when both people go home unhappy. In 1987 he ⑤ traded the van for a bicycle, and everybody said he had gone mad, and he said a van is eleven hundred pounds of trouble that has to be fed.

He never ⑥ traded with the big firms, though they asked him three times, and the reason he gave was that they paid in ninety days and he had never waited ninety days for anything in his life. He was, ⑦ by trade, a joiner, and by temperament something else entirely; my grandmother said the second was the reason the first never made them rich.

For eleven years he ⑧ traded on the same three streets: he bought at the yard on Monday, sold at the market on Saturday, and the eleven miles between the two was the whole of his business. He said the ⑨ trade in a thing is the difference between what it costs at the yard and what it is worth at the market, and that the difference is never in the thing.

When he died, in 1998, the ⑩ trade turned up: eleven men, every one of whom he had undercut at some point, and none of whom had spoken to him since 1974. They carried the coffin. My grandmother said that is what a trade is: not the work, and not the money, but eleven men who know exactly what you are and come anyway.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 贸易；买卖；生意
B. n. 行业；同业（the trade）
C. n. 手艺；行当；一门技术
D. n. 交易；交换（尤指以物易物）
E. v. 做买卖；做生意
F. v. 交换；互换（trade ... for ...）
G. 固定搭配：by trade 以……为业；干……这一行
H. 固定搭配：trade with ... 与……做生意

items.q: Everybody in the trade knew my grandfather
he had a trade and had learned it properly
He said a trade is not a living
The trade he was proudest of
he traded the van for a bicycle
He never traded with the big firms
He was, by trade, a joiner
he traded on the same three streets
the trade in a thing is the difference

answers.why: the trade 意为“同业、这一行的人”，方圆二十英里内干同一行的十一个人都认识我祖父。
a trade 意为“手艺、行当”，他有一门手艺，而且是正经学了七年学出来的。
a trade 意为“一门手艺、行当”，他说一门手艺不是谋生之道，而是别的一切都没了以后你手上还能做的事。
the trade 意为“交易、交换”，他最得意的一次交易根本不是活儿：1961 年他用十一袋苹果换了一台车床。
trade ... for ... 意为“用……换……”，1987 年他用货车换了一辆自行车。
trade with ... 意为“与……做生意”，他从不与大公司做生意，虽然他们请过他三次。
by trade 意为“以……为业、干……这一行”，论行当他是个细木工，论性情则完全是另一回事。
traded 是不及物动词，意为“做买卖、做生意”，他十一年里就在那三条街上做买卖。
the trade in a thing 意为“某样东西的买卖、生意”，他说一样东西的买卖就是场院里的进价与集市上的价钱之差。
the trade 意为“同业、同行”，他 1998 年去世时，同行都来了：十一个人，每一个都曾被他压过价。
